notes.title: Update notes for Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Please verify the integrity of your game files if you have already started playing to avoid any bugs!

Main Quest voiceovers are now AUTOMATIC! They will start as soon as the quest window opens (the buttons are still there to stop or replay the audio)
Changed the "Deliver requested items" button color and made it much larger
Changed the quest log buttons to the same color scheme
Changed Dad and Felix's idle animations (not hunched anymore)
Turned down intro ship ambient noise
Removed the main character's knee and elbow pads; also removed lights from boots
Added information to the Lab Droid's chat
Edited hints in User Guide
Fixed lighting in Mom's Office
Adjusted the volume of a few voiceovers
Changed Scarlet's voice

If you have any questions or suggestions, please join our discord!! https://discord.gg/sxmbrQzbz9

notes.title: Update notes for Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Please verify the integrity of your game files if you have already started playing to avoid any bugs!

We've been listening to your feedback, and we have made the following changes:
Updated portals to store your weapons AUTOMATICALLY before travel (no more lost weapons!)
Remapped keys so Flashlight is T and Lock-on is B
ESC can now be used to exit windows and to pause
Changed "Read Dialogue" button colors so they stand out
Removed controller information from tutorial hints (too wordy)
Adjusted User Guide hints
Added sounds to Chow Hall
Adjusted intro camera to go above doors instead of through them
Replaced large door on intro ship
Added checkpoint outside Sarhana1 research facility


If you have any questions or suggestions, please join our discord!! https://discord.gg/sxmbrQzbz9
